title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Nvidia Trims OpenAI Data Center Commitment: Wall Street Journal reports Nvidia scaled back its planned $250B compute commitment to OpenAI to under $120B.
Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 Unveiled: xAI announces its next-gen voice model featuring enhanced intelligence, higher transcription precision, and lower latency.
Corporate Earnings Outperform Market Prices: Bloomberg data reveals US corporate earnings are expanding faster than stock price valuations.
Marvel Studios Recasts Iron Man for 2028: Marvel announces 'Iron Man: Rebuilt' featuring Timothée Chalamet set to take on the iconic Tony Stark role in May 2028.
Commercial Aviation Inflight Starlink Expansion: United Airlines successfully deploys high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi enabling real-time FaceTime calls at cruising altitude.

items.title: @FirstSquawk: Nvidia Adjusts OpenAI Data Center Commitment
items.body: Wall Street Journal reports that Nvidia has scaled back its planned $250 billion OpenAI data center commitment to under $120 billion as infrastructure scaling models undergo strategic revision.

items.title: @SpaceXAI: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 Launch
items.body: SpaceX/xAI released Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, introducing a next-generation voice architecture with boosted intelligence, higher transcription accuracy, and ultra-low conversational latency.

items.title: @EdLudlow: United Airlines Starlink Inflight FaceTime
items.body: United Airlines has begun rolling out SpaceX Starlink satellite internet on commercial flights, providing gigabit-class low-latency bandwidth that supports live FaceTime video calls at 35,000 feet.

items.title: @GeminiApp: Google Gemini Desktop & Mobile Feature Drop

items.title: @floraai: Flora AI Releases Fashion Studio
